defs.def: to say numbers in the correct order （按顺序）数数

ex.s: There was just one thing I hadn’t counted on: My brother chose to bring his dog Toby, a 50-pound ball of fire.
ex.t: 只有一件事我没料到：我弟弟选择带上他的狗Toby——一个50磅重的小火球。

ex.s: Your attitude and effort count a lot.
ex.t: 你的态度和努力很重要。

ex.s: Marian Bechtel sits at West Palm Beach’s Bar Louie counter by herself, quietly reading her e-book as she waits for her salad.
ex.t: 玛丽安·贝克特尔独自坐在西棕榈滩Bar Louie餐厅的吧台前，安静地读着电子书，等待她的沙拉。

ex.s: From now on I will only be editing articles for PsyBlog while wearing a white coat to help keep the typing error count low.
ex.t: 从现在起，我只会在穿着白大褂的情况下编辑PsyBlog的文章，以帮助减少打字错误的数量。

defs.def: to calculate the total number of people, things, etc. in a particular group 计算（或清点）总数

ex.s: In the past few years, an increasing number of people and organisations have begun coming up with plans to counter this trend.
ex.t: 过去几年里，越来越多的人和组织开始提出计划来遏制这一趋势。

defs.def: to include sb/sth when you calculate a total 把 … 算入；包括

ex.s: When it comes to in-person humor, effort counts a lot.
ex.t: 对于面对面的幽默来说，努力很重要。

ex.s: Whatever you decide, you can count on my complete support.
ex.t: 无论你决定什么，你都可以完全指望我的支持。

ex.s: Some ecotourism holidays involve voluntary work, such as planting trees or counting endangered animals.
ex.t: 一些生态旅游假期包括志愿工作，如植树或统计濒危动物。

defs.def: to be important 不用于进行时
to be officially accepted; to accept sth officially （被）正式接纳，正式认可

ex.s: First, the Earth Engines would be used to stop the rotation of the Earth, with all the jets set to counter the planet’s movement.
ex.t: 首先，地球引擎将被用来停止地球的自转，所有喷射器都设置成对抗地球的运动。

ex.s: I love Robutt and that’s what counts.” And the little robot-mutt, which had never been held so tightly in all its existence, squeaked high and rapid squeaks-happy squeaks.
ex.t: 我爱罗布特，这才是最重要的。"而这个小机器人小狗——从未被如此紧紧地抱过——发出了又快又高的吱吱声——快乐的吱吱声。

defs.def: to consider sb/sth in a particular way; to be considered in a particular way 认为；看作；算作；被视为
an act of counting to find the total number of sth; the total number that you find 数出总数；总数

ex.s: 20     It’s rare to hear someone say, “I wish that speaker had spoken longer.” On the other hand, you probably can’t count the times that you’ve thought, “I’m glad that talk is over.
ex.t: 20     很少听到有人说："我希望那位演讲者能讲得更久。"另一方面，你可能数不清有多少次你想："真高兴那个演讲终于结束了。"它似乎永远没完没了！所以给你的听众一个惊喜吧。

defs.def: an act of saying numbers in order beginning with 1 （按顺序的）数数，点数
a measurement of the amount of sth contained in a particular substance or area （某物在某物质或面积中）量的计数
a crime that sb is accused of committing （被指控的）罪状，事项
a point made during a discussion or an argument （讨论或争论的）论点，观点，问题，事项
(in some European countries) a nobleman of high rank, similar to an earl in Britain 伯爵（欧洲一些国家相当于英国 earl 的贵族封号）
unable to get up again within ten seconds after being knocked down 拳击手
in a deep sleep 熟睡；酣睡
